item.text: {"representations":[{"case_ref":"sample_163b1862742bf872","text":"Across March 30–April 12, sleep increased abruptly and persisted for all 14 nights: 448 versus 328.5 minutes in the 28-day baseline (+119.5 minutes, 36%).
